description: This PHP class defines a model named LeaveBalanceModel within the OrangeHRM leave plugin API. It represents leave balance data including properties like entitled, used, scheduled, pending, taken, balance, asAtDate, endDate. The class integrates serialization traits and initializes with a LeaveBalance entity, configuring filters and attribute names pertinent to leave balance information.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceModel
classes.description: A data model class for leave balance information, implementing normalization and serialization logic for the leave plugin API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a LeaveBalance entity, setting filters and attribute names used for serialization.
